description: This is a small, oval-shaped wooden table with four tapered legs. It has a single drawer with a round brass knob. A patterned cloth drapes over the top of the table, hanging over one side. The table has decorative brass accents at the top of each leg. The wood appears to have a rich, dark finish with visible grain. The overall design suggests a vintage or antique aesthetic, possibly intended for a bedroom or dressing area.
